scope: As-used local motion playback comparison. Callback rates are not presented FPS or GPU/display latency. Diagnostic altered-document runs are excluded.

method.median: Conventional middle value, averaging the middle pair for an even sample count
method.p95: Nearest rank: sorted sample at ceil(0.95 * n), counting from one
method.renderer: eframe WGPU on isolated Sway; compositor GLES renderer Apple M1 Pro (G13S C0)
method.clock: Unmodified egui time; production f32 elapsed delta, f32 playhead addition, duration loop/clamp. Clock anchor immediately precedes the first playback sample.
method.resource_scope: Whole process including startup/warmup/verification; ru_maxrss KiB on Linux
